scope: Rejected IO timing experiments; no shifts of IO accesses or PPU edges are retained. A separate native interrupt-fetch correction is validated under retained_correction. Raw LCD write-clock separation stays explicit; architectural dispatch and witnesses match. Commercial release validation remains incomplete.
rejection_reason: The general IO correction changes a DMA snapshot contract and regresses the uniform-startup private counterexample even with synchronized reference pixels. A LCD/IF-only alternative restores that title but regresses seven authored STAT/LY controls. IO timing was preserved; native interrupt-fetch recognition supplies the retained correction.
reproduction_note: The rejected patches are rebased onto the validated interrupt-fetch implementation: they disable its late-fetch decision while retaining the host-only interrupt observer API, then reproduce the historical IO timing alternatives. Apply only in an isolated checkout at this recorded base hash.
